name: Quail
siboNotes: Excellent protein choice for SIBO as it's naturally FODMAP-free and easily digestible when prepared simply.
preparationTips: Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like rosemary, thyme, or oregano
Cook with garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Roast or grill for best digestibility
Remove skin if experiencing fat sensitivity during SIBO treatment
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of phosphorus and selenium
Lower in fat than duck, higher in protein than chicken
